title: Document classification manifest
description: Which schedules each document belongs to. Produced by an AI pass over the document tree, reviewed by a human, then committed. Extraction runs read this file -- they never re-ask the model where a document belongs, so routing stays deterministic between runs.

path.description: Exactly as given in the input listing, relative to the AY source root.

kind.description: What this document is, in plain words: 'Form 16 Part B', 'broker capital-gains statement', 'savings account statement'.

tabs.description: Tab ids this belongs to. Empty means it belongs to no schedule. Several is normal and correct -- a broker tax P&L feeds both Capital Gains and Business.

confidence.description: low means you guessed from the filename and could not confirm it.

why.description: The evidence. Say whether it came from the filename alone or from opening the file.

opened.description: True if you read the file rather than judging by name.

reported_summary.description: True for a document that states figures REPORTED TO the department or aggregated by it -- the AIS, the TIS, Form 26AS. These are never a source of ledger rows, and every schedule's reconciliation is given them whatever tabs they are routed to. A broker's own statement is not one of these.
